{{pkmn|Sun and Moon|Sun, Moon}}, {{pkmn|Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon|Ultra Sun, Ultra Moon}} }} {{Character Infobox/Anime |color={{Alola color light}} |series=''[[Pokémon the Series]]'' |debut=''[[SM044|A Dream Encounter!]]'' |counterpart=[[Professor Burnet (anime)]] |enva=[[Melissa Schoenberg|Melissa Hope]] |jpva=[[Sachi Kokuryū]] }} {{Character Infobox/Manga |color={{Alola color light}} |series=''[[Pokémon Adventures]]'' |debut=''[[PS541|Pink Slip]]'' }} |} '''Professor Burnet''' (Japanese: '''バーネット博士''' ''Dr. Burnet'') is a researcher who debuted in [[Pokémon Dream Radar]] and reappears in {{pkmn|Sun and Moon|Pokémon Sun, Moon}}, {{pkmn|Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon|Ultra Sun, and Ultra Moon}}. Her research specializes in the relationship between the [[Pokémon universe]] and other [[dimension]]s. ==In the games== ===Character profile=== Professor Burnet is a researcher who studies Pokémon in other [[dimension]]s and the [[Interdream Zone]], the space between dreams and reality. Burnet comes off as a passionate woman who enjoys her job and relationships. Burnet can feel easily flustered. Burnet appears to have a habit of snapping her fingers when she figures something out and She grins when something she finds amuses her. Professor Burnet is married to [[Professor Kukui]] who she lives with on Alola's {{rt|1|alola}} on [[Melemele Island]]. She appears to find the [[Professor Kukui|Masked Royal]] attractive, often smiling and blushing at the thought of him. During the end scene of Sun and Moon, she notices the similarities between her husband and the Royal. In [[Pokémon Dream Radar]], she mentioned that she was colleagues with Professor [[Fennel]] in the [[Unova]] region, who also had an interest in researching the dreams of Pokémon. According to [[Lillie]], Professor Burnet treats Lillie like her own daughter. ===Appearance=== [[File:Burnet SM concept art.png|thumb|left|250px|Burnet's concept art as she appears in {{g|Sun and Moon}}]] Professor Burnet is an adult woman who stands at the height of 5'7" (1.70 m). In the Alola-based games, Burnet appears to have more tanned skin than she does in Pokémon Dream Radar. In both games, she has medium-length white hair that stands up on end with two curly side bangs and a long ponytail that curves upward ending in 5 points. She has thin eyebrows with almond-shaped eyes and yellow irises. ====Pokémon Dream Radar==== Burnet's head is covered by a pair of large thick goggles that wrap around her head with a gray strap. The lens are angular and are yellow with crosshairs, a symbol used across the game is also applied to the bridge on the goggle's nose. Burnet wears a one-piece black jumpsuit, that is decorated with multiple colors and lines appearing in green, blue and gold around her chest with a gray chest plate on the front. This jumpsuit is a bit larger for her and becomes baggy near her ankles. Large open boots cover her feet and shins, having a single gold line down the front, ending at the ankles. The Jumpsuit's sleeves, decorated with orange lines, reach towards her arms, stopping beneath her gloves. Burnet wears white wool gloves, with multiple seams. Like most Pokémon Professors, Burnet has a large white lab coat, the sleeves are pulled back towards her elbows and has large pockets on both sides. Her coat is often left open. ====Generation VII==== In Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon, Burnet wears a green headband that covers the backside of her head, this headband is similar in shape to the strap of her goggles from Dream Radar. Burnet has a silver metal chain necklace ending with her wedding ring. Burnet's gray thin-strap tank top lacks detail aside from the seems on the sides. She wears a jumpsuit, similar to the black and orange jumpsuit that she had originally worn in Dream Radar, as leggings, the upper half is tied around her waist on top of a blue skirt. The leggings are also connected to her shoes, having green soles that cover her toes. The top of her feet are open. If Burnet were to wear her jumpsuit completely, the sleeves would go down her entire arm length like in Dream Radar. The jumpsuit has a zipper that goes down the middle. ===Pokémon Dream Radar=== Professor Burnet conducts research on the Pokémon found in the Interdream Zone, and develops extensions and upgrades to the player's Beam and Vivoscope by harvesting [[Dream Cloud|Dream Orb]]s. These upgrades are used to catch the [[forces of nature]] in their [[List of Pokémon with form differences#Forces of Nature|Therian Forme]]s. ===Pokémon Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon=== Burnet made her [[core series]] debut in [[Pokémon Sun and Moon]], where she is revealed to have married [[Professor Kukui]] of [[Alola]]. Three months prior to the start of the story, Burnet had found [[Lillie]] lying on a beach, with a weakened {{p|Cosmog}} named [[Nebby]] in her bag. She contacts her husband who proceeds bring the young girl to {{rt|1|alola}} to live in the Pokémon Research Lab's Loft. Ever since, she and her husband have been helping Lillie find out more about Nebby. After the {{player}} completes the three [[Island challenge#trial|island trial]]s in [[Akala Island]], Kukui invites the player to the Dimensional Research Lab in [[Heahea City]], where she has been researching the strange phenomena occurring in the Alola region, [[Ultra Wormhole]]s and the [[Ultra Beast]]s. Burnet offers the player the [[Reveal Glass]] later in the games. In Sun and Moon, Lillie leaves for the [[Kanto]] region in hopes of helping her mother, Professor Kukui makes the claim that Burnet was too sad to see Lillie go and that she is allowed to use the space in the loft whenever she pleases. Burnet and Professor Kukui suggest that [[Z-Power]] comes from Ultra Wormholes. Professor Burnet appears alongside her husband and his [[Professor Kukui's Lycanroc|Rockruff]] during the credits of Sun and Moon. This photograph is implied to have been taken by the {{player}} and was sent to Lillie in a package. Her role in [[Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon]] is nearly identical, with only the ending of the game being changed as Lillie never leaves Alola. ==In spin-off games== ===[[Pokémon Masters EX]]=== While not appearing directly, Profesor Kukui mentions in off hand conversation at the [[Pokémon Center]] that Professor Burnet has arrived on [[Pasio]] too. ==Quotes== {{main|Professor Burnet/Quotes}} ==In animation== [[File:Professor Burnet anime.png|thumb|250px|Professor Burnet in {{aniseries|SM}}]] ===''Pokémon the Series''=== {{main|Professor Burnet (anime)}} Professor Burnet is a recurring character in {{aniseries|SM}}, debuting in ''[[SM044|A Dream Encounter!]]''. Partway through the [[series]], she becomes {{an|Professor Kukui}}'s wife, similar to the {{pkmn|games}}. She reappears in {{aniseries|JN}}, along with her husband and their newborn son, [[Lei]]. {{-}} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Masked Royal Professor Burnet Adventures.png|thumb|200px|Professor Burnet in Pokémon Adventures]] [[File:Professor Burnet B2W2 chapter.png|thumb|150px|left|Professor Burnet in the {{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}]] ====History==== ====={{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}===== Professor Burnet debuted in this chapter. She was first seen in a fantasy in ''[[PS541|Pink Slip]]'', where she was mentioned by [[Fennel]], who said she was a great help to her research on [[Dream Mist]]. ====={{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}}===== Burnet moved to the [[Alola]] region and married [[Professor Kukui]]. Three months prior to the start of the chapter, Burnet found [[Lillie]] and [[Nebby|a Pokémon]] lying unconscious on a beach. In ''[[PASM04|The Decision and the Tournament of Six]]'', she was seen with Lillie at [[Professor Kukui]]'s house, where they watched a tournament being held at an [[Iki Town]] festival on the television. Burnet was excited to see the Masked Royal battle against {{adv|Sun}} in the first round, but was disappointed when he ends up losing. Later, Burnet received several Pokémon documents from Kukui while he was at the Dimensional Research Lab. As they talked, Burnet revealed that Nebby is actually the [[Legendary Pokémon]] {{p|Cosmog}}. Burnet suggested that Lillie may have been trying to keep Nebby away from someone, but she refused to clarify who she was trying to escape from. To Kukui's surprise, Burnet suggested that he make Lillie his assistant, as it could help her begin to open up more. Later, Burnet decided to take Lillie shopping in order to get her out of the house more. As they headed towards [[Hau'oli City]]'s boutique, Burnet accidentally triggered painful memories of Lillie's past. Lillie's distress caused Nebby to fly out and begin clawing at the sky, creating a [[Ultra Wormhole|crack in the sky]] in the process. When Lillie eventually fainted, Nebby stopped and went down to check on her condition out of concern. Later that day, Burnet contacted Professor Kukui, {{adv|Sun}}, {{adv|Moon}}, and their friends and told them all about what happened to Lillie. With this information, everyone speculated that the various cracks seen around Alola were caused by Nebby and that Lillie must have been running away from some villains in order to keep Nebby from them. Worried that she may not be able to keep Lillie safe alone, Professor Kukui suggested Burnet meet up with him, Sun, and Moon at [[Ula'ula Island]]. Later, Burnet and Lillie used [[Mantine Surf]] to travel over the water to Professor Kukui's yacht as it headed off to Ula'ula. Shortly after arriving, the group was attacked by a wild {{p|Bruxish}}, which used its psychic powers to give everyone headaches and pass out. Although Sun successfully rescued Lillie, who was knocked into the water, he and Lillie ended up passing out as well and are separated from the others. Later, Burnet, Kukui, and Moon were rescued by the [[Aether Foundation]] and taken to [[Aether Paradise]]. There, they met [[Faba]] and [[Wicke]], who explained what happened to everyone and offered to give a tour of Aether Paradise. Later, after leaving Aether Paradise, Burnet, Kukui, and Moon took Kukui's yacht to Ula'ula Island. Kukui, sensing a strange change in the atmosphere, feared that a battle may have started in the hour since the Captains' group arrived at [[Po Town]] to talk with [[Team Skull]]. With nowhere to dock the yacht, Moon told Kukui to get as close to Ula'ula as he can while she had Rowlet carry her to Po Town by flying through the air. After finding a place to dock, Burnet and Kukui met back up with Sun and Moon in Po Town. Kukui gave Sun one of the [[Mirage Berry|Mirage Berries]] that was left behind on the yacht so that Sun and Moon could feed it to {{p|Tapu Bulu}}. Later, Burnet went off to the [[Aether House]] to meet up with Lillie. When Lillie spotted [[Gladion]] fighting off one of the [[Ultra Beasts]] that had been rampaging around Alola, she ran off to go see him. When Lillie arrived at Gladion's location, she was attacked by a {{p|Guzzlord}}. Though Burnet tried to protect Lillie, both were saved by Gladion's {{TP|Gladion|Silvally}}. To everyone's surprise, Lillie and Gladion revealed themselves to be siblings as well as the children of Aether Foundation President, [[Lusamine]]. Lillie explained that three months ago, she stole Nebby from Lusamine in order to prevent her from using its power to further her plans. When Lillie presented a [[Sun Flute]] she also took from Aether Paradise, Gladion decided that they should head towards the altar. In ''[[PASM37|Finale!! The Battle Against the Other Dimension!]]'', Burnet was revealed to have learned of Kukui's identity as the Masked Royal, leading to them now participating together at the [[Battle Royal Dome]] as "Luran and Kommo". ====Pokémon==== =====Ride Pokémon===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Professor Burnet |pkmn=Mantine |type1=Water |type2=Flying |img=Professor Burnet Lillie Mantine Surf Adventures.png |epnum=PASM15 |epname=Shipwreck and "Oh, What Sharp Teeth You Have, Bruxish!" |desc=Professor Burnet used a [[Poké Ride|Ride]] {{p|Mantine}} to surf to [[Professor Kukui]]'s yacht with [[Lillie]]. Shortly after arriving, a wild {{p|Bruxish}} arrived and attacked everyone with its psychic abilities. During the commotion, Mantine collided into the yacht, knocking itself out in the process. It was later rescued alongside everyone and taken to [[Aether Paradise]] to be healed from its injuries.
